_comment: Your look (2026-10-18): the design tokens every look-aware Motion Graphics template takes its colours, fonts, corners, shadow, grain and easing from. Edit freely, then: .venv\Scripts\python tools\templates.py looks sync (rewrites the templates' defaults + the shared look.css / looks.js). Fonts = families of the font library (tools\fonts.py list). Sizes in px for a 1080-px short side; shadow / grain 0 = none.
name: Editorial warm
what: Editorial, warm, tactile, confident. Paper and ink with one hot signal colour; a serif headline, a clean grotesk, a mono for small labels. Soft low shadows, light film grain. Not glossy, not neon.

motion._comment: GSAP ease names. Entrances expo-out, exits expo-in, short holds; 'bounce' only where the reference clearly bounces.
